svg.title: Annual carbon out (total ecosystem respiration TER plus the carbon that management takes out, minus the carbon that it brings in) against annual gross primary production (GPP), one marker per site-year, with the SMEAR II Hyytiälä forest as a reference; below the 1:1 line the site-year was a net carbon sink (NBE < 0).
svg.desc: Scatter plot of 20 site-years (full and reliable years with annual GPP, TER and NBE): 14 of the six sites and 6 of the SMEAR II Hyytiälä forest (green stars). X axis annual GPP (g C m−2 yr−1), from 600 to 1600; y axis annual carbon out = TER + C_out − C_in (total ecosystem respiration plus the carbon that management takes out, minus the carbon that it brings in; g C m−2 yr−1), from 400 to 3600 (the y axis is longer than the x axis, so the scales differ). The vertical distance from the dotted 1:1 line is NBE: above the line the field lost carbon (NBE > 0), below it gained carbon. Light dotted lines mark NBE = −200 and −400 g C m−2 yr−1. A grey line links each marker to a short grey tick at y = TER, the position without management carbon (NEE). Filled markers are class A (8 site-years of the six sites), hollow markers with a bar are class B (6; the bar spans the low to high NBE of the assumptions). For the six sites, NBE was 24 ± 142 g C m−2 yr−1 (mean ± SD, range −377 to 177, n = 14); NEE was −51 ± 132 (range −283 to 131). 6 site-years had NEE > 0 and 9 had NBE > 0. C_out − C_in was 74 ± 219 (range −466, Qvidja 2023, to 363, Anttila 2023). Lowest NBE: Qvidja 2023, −377; highest: Haltiala 2025 oats, 177. Class B (NBE, low to high): Haltiala 2023 97 (−89 to 108); Qvidja 2020 −81 (−96 to −72); Qvidja 2023 −377 (−471 to −336); Qvidja 2025 0 (−1 to 17); Viikki 2024 −17 (−163 to 11); Viikki 2025 109 (103 to 115). Hyytiälä 2020 (thinning): NEE 115, the commercial removal of 2310 gives NBE 2425 (range 1605 to 2555), carbon out 3393; the other Hyytiälä years have NBE = NEE, −248 to −144. Each site has its own colour and marker; labels give the year and, for annual crops and the failed grass, the crop.
